subScenes.name: 咨询借书流程
subScenes.description: 询问图书馆如何借书及所需证件。

qaPairs.triggerText: How do I borrow a book?

followUps.text: First, you need a library card. I can help you register for one right now.
followUps.text_cn: 首先，你需要一张借书卡，我现在可以帮你注册。

followUps.text: You already have a card? Just scan your book at the self-checkout machine over there.
followUps.text_cn: 你已经有卡了？直接去那边的自助借还机扫描书籍即可。

followUps.text: Some books can only be borrowed online through our app. Would you like me to show you how?
followUps.text_cn: 有些书只能通过我们的App在线借阅，要我教你怎么做吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于初次借书者询问基本流程，涵盖办卡、自助、线上三种主流方式

qaPairs.triggerText: How long can I keep the book?

followUps.text: Standard books are due in 21 days. You can renew them once online if no one else is waiting.
followUps.text_cn: 普通书籍借期21天，如果没有别人预约，你可以在线续借一次。

followUps.text: Reference books like encyclopedias can't be borrowed out—they're for in-library use only.
followUps.text_cn: 参考书如百科全书不能外借，仅限馆内使用。

followUps.text: Students can borrow for 30 days, and faculty up to 60. Are you a student or staff?
followUps.text_cn: 学生可借30天，教职员工最长60天。你是学生还是教职员工？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用户关心借阅期限，回应需区分普通书、参考书、身份差异三种情况

qaPairs.triggerText: Can I reserve a book that's currently checked out?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 如果书已经被借走了，我能预约吗？

followUps.text: Yes, we can place a hold on it. You'll get an email when it's returned and ready for pickup.
followUps.text_cn: 可以，我们可以帮你预约。书归还后我们会发邮件通知你来取。

followUps.text: We don't allow holds on bestsellers—they're on a first-come, first-served basis.
followUps.text_cn: 畅销书不支持预约，按先到先得原则借阅。

followUps.text: You can reserve it now, but you'll need to pick it up within 7 days after notification, or it goes to the next person.
followUps.text_cn: 你现在可以预约，但收到通知后必须在7天内取书，否则会转给下一位。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用户询问预约机制，回应需覆盖支持预约、不支持预约、有取书时限三种典型情况

subScenes.name: 确认借阅数量
subScenes.description: 了解一次最多能借几本书。

qaPairs.triggerText: How many books would you like to borrow today?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 图书馆工作人员确认借阅数量

followUps.text: I'd like to borrow three books, please.
followUps.text_cn: 我想借三本书，谢谢。

followUps.text: Is there a limit? I only wanted one, but I might take more.
followUps.text_cn: 有数量限制吗？我本来想借一本，但可能再多借几本。

followUps.text: Actually, I’ll just take two for now—I’ll come back later for the third.
followUps.text_cn: 其实我先借两本吧，我稍后再来借第三本。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于图书馆工作人员确认借书数量时，用户根据不同意图（明确、犹豫、分批）做出自然回应

qaPairs.triggerText: You can borrow up to five books at a time. Is that okay?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 一次最多可以借五本书，可以吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 工作人员告知限额并确认用户接受

followUps.text: Perfect, I’ll take five!
followUps.text_cn: 太好了，我就借五本！

followUps.text: Actually, I only need two—I don’t want to overload myself.
followUps.text_cn: 其实我只需要两本，不想借太多。

followUps.text: Can I borrow more if I return some next week?
followUps.text_cn: 如果我下周还几本，能借更多吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 当工作人员告知借阅上限时，用户根据个人需求、自律性或规则探索做出不同回应

qaPairs.triggerText: Are you sure you want to borrow all four? That’s your full allowance.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您确定要借这四本吗？这已经是您的最大限额了。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 工作人员提醒用户已达借阅上限，确认最终决定

followUps.text: Yes, I’m sure—I’ve planned my reading list carefully.
followUps.text_cn: 是的，我确定，我已经仔细规划好了阅读计划。

followUps.text: Hmm, maybe I should return one first—let me check my shelf.
followUps.text_cn: 嗯，也许我该先还一本——让我看看书架上有没有。

followUps.text: Wait, can I borrow one more if I leave my ID here?
followUps.text_cn: 等等，如果我把身份证留在这儿，能多借一本吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 当工作人员提醒已达限额时，用户表现出自信、谨慎或试探性态度，体现真实心理变化

subScenes.name: 询问归还期限
subScenes.description: 咨询书籍的借阅天数和到期日。

qaPairs.triggerText: How long can you keep this book?

followUps.text: Two weeks, please. I’ll return it on time.
followUps.text_cn: 两周，谢谢。我会按时归还。

followUps.text: Can I renew it if I need more time?
followUps.text_cn: 如果我需要更多时间，可以续借吗？

followUps.text: Is there a shorter loan period for popular books?
followUps.text_cn: 畅销书的借阅期会更短吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于向图书馆工作人员询问标准借阅期限，适用于初次借书或不确定规则的学习者

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you have a grace period for late returns?

followUps.text: Yes, I have a 3-day grace period.
followUps.text_cn: 有的，我有3天宽限期。

followUps.text: I’m sorry, I forgot — will I be fined?
followUps.text_cn: 不好意思，我忘了，会罚款吗？

followUps.text: What happens if I don’t return it at all?
followUps.text_cn: 如果我根本不归还会怎样？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于了解逾期后果，帮助学习者应对可能的归还延迟情况

qaPairs.triggerText: Can I borrow this book if I’m not a member?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我不是会员，能借这本书吗？

followUps.text: Yes, you can sign up right now and borrow today.
followUps.text_cn: 可以，你现在注册就能今天借书。

followUps.text: I’m afraid you need a membership first — it’s free.
followUps.text_cn: 很抱歉，您需要先办理会员，但免费。

followUps.text: Can I just read it here in the library?
followUps.text_cn: 我能在图书馆里读吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 帮助非会员用户了解借阅资格与替代方案，覆盖从注册到放弃的多种决策路径

subScenes.name: 申请续借服务
subScenes.description: 询问是否可以延长借阅时间。

qaPairs.triggerText: Would you like to renew this book?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 图书馆工作人员主动询问是否需要续借

followUps.text: Yes, please. I still need it for my research.
followUps.text_cn: 请帮我续借，我还在做研究用。

followUps.text: No, thanks. I'm done with it.
followUps.text_cn: 不用了，我已经看完了。

followUps.text: Can I renew it if someone else has a hold?
followUps.text_cn: 如果有人预约了这本书，我还能续借吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于回应图书馆员关于续借的主动询问，体现不同态度与情境

qaPairs.triggerText: How many times can you renew this book?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 这本书最多能续借几次？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 用户主动询问续借次数限制

followUps.text: You can renew it once, as long as no one else has requested it.
followUps.text_cn: 只要没人预约，您可以续借一次。

followUps.text: Unfortunately, this title can't be renewed at all. It's in high demand.
followUps.text_cn: 很抱歉，这本书完全不能续借，因为需求量很大。

followUps.text: You're allowed two renewals, but only if the book isn't reserved by another user.
followUps.text_cn: 您可以续借两次，前提是没人预约这本书。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用户询问续借次数时，馆员根据不同书籍状态给出标准回应

qaPairs.triggerText: I'd like to renew my books, please.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我想续借我的书，请问可以吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 用户主动提出续借请求

followUps.text: Sure! All your books have been renewed successfully. The new due date is next Friday.
followUps.text_cn: 当然可以！您的所有书籍都已成功续借，新到期日是下周五。

followUps.text: I'm sorry, but one of your books has been reserved by another patron. You'll need to return it by tomorrow.
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，您的一本书已被他人预约，您需要在明天之前归还。

followUps.text: You've reached the maximum number of renewals for these items. You can check them out again after returning them.
followUps.text_cn: 您已达到这些书籍的续借上限，归还后可以重新借阅。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用户提出续借请求后，馆员根据系统状态给出三种典型结果回应

subScenes.name: 感谢并离开
subScenes.description: 完成借书后礼貌致谢并告别。

qaPairs.triggerText: Thank you for returning the books on time.
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 图书馆借书场景：感谢并离开

followUps.text: You're welcome! I really enjoyed this book.
followUps.text_cn: 不客气！我真的很喜欢这本书。

followUps.text: No problem! I’ll be back next week for another one.
followUps.text_cn: 没问题！我下周再来借一本。

followUps.text: Thanks for your help!
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢你的帮助！

qaPairs.usageNote: 这是图书馆工作人员在归还书籍时常见的感谢语，用户需自然回应以完成礼貌告别。三种回应分别体现情感表达、未来意图和简洁收尾，符合真实语境。

qaPairs.triggerText: Is there anything else I can help you with today?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 今天还有其他我可以帮您的吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 图书馆借书场景：感谢并离开

followUps.text: No, that’s all, thanks! Have a great day!
followUps.text_cn: 不用了，就这些，谢谢！祝你今天愉快！

followUps.text: Actually, could you tell me when the new novels arrive?
followUps.text_cn: 其实，你能告诉我新小说什么时候到货吗？

followUps.text: All set! Thanks again.
followUps.text_cn: 搞定啦！再次感谢。

qaPairs.usageNote: 工作人员常在服务结束前询问是否需要其他帮助，用户回应需体现是否继续互动。三种回应覆盖：礼貌结束、临时追问、简洁致谢，均为高频真实反应。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 图书馆借书场景：感谢并离开

followUps.text: I love this place! It’s so quiet and helpful.
followUps.text_cn: 我超爱这个地方！安静又贴心。

followUps.text: Same to you! See you soon.
followUps.text_cn: 你也一样！回头见。

followUps.text: Appreciate it!
followUps.text_cn: 非常感谢！

qaPairs.usageNote: 这是图书馆工作人员在用户离开时的标准化告别语。用户回应需体现礼貌与情感，三种回应分别展示赞美、互致问候和高效告别，符合真实口语习惯。
